description: Source code for a web-based database browser interface, including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for dynamic content loading and user interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of available databases from the server.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching data from the server.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables within a selected database and loads table data.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables within a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Creates HTML to display table data in a formatted grid.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Renders individual cell content based on data type and length, including expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for objects or long strings.
